hero.subtitle_html: Gfellen → Risetestock → Blaue Tosse — SAC T4 · ~820 m gain · ~4 h traverse

intro_html: The Risetestock (1758 m) is a western outcrop of the Pilatus range, rising above the small hamlet of Gfellen in the Entlebuch. The SAC-rated T4 traverse from Gfellen to Blaue Tosse crosses exposed terrain opposite the Schimberig, with 820 m of ascent through steep alpine ground.

bullets_html: Start: Gfellen (~938 m) — ascend 820 m to Risetestock summit.
Summit: Risetestock (1758 m) — western Pilatus range, opposite Schimberig.
Descent: Continue traverse to Blaue Tosse (~1.5 h descent, 820 m loss).
SAC time: 2h30 ascent + 1h30 descent = ~4 h total.

getting_there.by_pt_html:
• Train to Schüpfheim (BLS Entlebuch line from Bern or Luzern).
  • PostBus to Gfellen (Finsterwald b. Entlebuch).
  • Plan via sbb.ch.
getting_there.by_car_html: Drive to Gfellen (6162 Finsterwald b. Entlebuch) via Schüpfheim or Entlebuch. Limited parking at the hamlet.

day_plans.footer_html: SAC reference times: 2h30 ascent, 1h30 descent. Adjust for conditions and fitness.

lapse_rate.example_html: Example: Schüpfheim forecast 22 °C → summit ≈ ~16 °C. Add wind chill on exposed sections.

weather.season_html: June to October is best. T4 terrain requires dry conditions; avoid after fresh snow or rain.

safety_html: T4 terrain: Exposed sections require sure-footedness and a head for heights. Hands may be needed in places.
Wet conditions: Steep grass and rock become dangerous when wet — postpone if rain is forecast.
Turn back if thunderstorms develop — lightning risk above treeline is extreme.
disclaimer_html: This page is an informal hike plan, not professional mountain-safety advice. Conditions change rapidly. Always check MeteoSwiss and SAC before setting out.
